name: BookingDaddy – Booking & Appointment Made Bold, Easy, and Smart
author: ConicPlex

sections.description:
BookingDaddy is a powerful, flexible, and easy-to-use WooCommerce-based booking plugin that enables businesses to accept online bookings and appointments seamlessly. Whether you run a turf rental (futsal, box cricket), salon, swimming pool, clinic, fitness center, tuition classes, or offer hourly-based services, this plugin simplifies scheduling and payments.

With real-time pricing updates, multiple time slot selection, customizable booking forms, and a powerful admin calendar view, BookingDaddy is the ideal solution for service-based businesses.

🔥 Why Choose BookingDaddy?
✅ WooCommerce Integration – Securely accept online payments via WooCommerce
✅ Flexible Bookings – Set available days, off days, weekly off-days, and more
✅ Time Slot Management – Auto-generate time slots based on start time, end time, duration & buffer time
✅ Real-time Price Calculation – Base price + extra fees + price per adult or child (customizable)
✅ Multiple Time Selection – Allow users to book multiple slots in one order (if enabled)
✅ Booking Calendar View – Manage appointments with monthly, weekly, and daily views
✅ Fully Customizable – Modify colors, borders, fonts, labels, and error messages
✅ Mobile-Friendly & Easy to Use – No coding required, just install & start booking
✅ Seamless Email Notifications – Keep customers informed about their bookings
✅ Multi-Niche Compatibility – Perfect for various industries & business types

🎯 Ideal for:
Turf rentals & sports facilities – Futsal, box cricket, badminton courts

Salons & spas – Appointment scheduling for beauty & wellness services

Swimming pools – Booking pool slots & swimming classes

Clinics & healthcare – Doctor & therapy session appointments

Fitness centers & gyms – Personal training & class bookings

Freelancers & consultants – Hourly-based service bookings

Coaching & tuition classes – Scheduling online & offline sessions

Event & workshop organizers – Managing workshop registrations

And many more businesses that need online booking solutions

📌 Benefits for Your Business:
✔️ Automate appointment scheduling and save time
✔️ Accept online payments securely via WooCommerce
✔️ Avoid overbooking with real-time slot availability
✔️ Offer a seamless mobile-friendly booking experience to customers
✔️ Reduce no-shows with instant booking confirmations

Benefits for Your Customers:
✔️ Simple and fast booking process
✔️ Transparent pricing with real-time calculations
✔️ Easy selection of available time slots
✔️ Mobile-friendly interface for bookings on the go
✔️ Secure payments and instant booking confirmation

sections.installation:
Install WooCommerce if not already installed.

Upload BookingDaddy to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via WordPress Plugin Installer.

Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.

Go to WooCommerce > Products and select Bookable Product as the product type.

Configure booking settings, time slots, pricing, and availability.

Start accepting bookings instantly!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce is required for this plugin to function, as it utilizes WooCommerce’s checkout and payment system.

Can I allow users to book multiple time slots?

Yes! Admins can enable multiple time slot selection while setting up the bookable product.

Can I customize the booking form design?

Absolutely! You can customize colors, fonts, borders, and even labels and error messages to match your website’s theme.

Does this support online payments?

Yes, since it integrates with WooCommerce, it supports all WooCommerce payment gateways.

Can I set different prices for adults and children?

Yes, you can define pricing per adult, child, or other custom units.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes! BookingDaddy is 100% mobile responsive for a smooth user experience.

How do I view my bookings?

Admin can view bookings in a calendar format with monthly, weekly, and daily views.

Can I use this for hourly-based bookings?

Yes, this plugin is ideal for freelancers, consultants, tutors, and hourly-based service providers.
